name: Data Curator
description: Agent-driven metadata governance with custom objects, Flows, and Agentforce actions

initialMessages.content: Help me build a metadata governance app for Salesforce admins. I want a dashboard that shows org health at a glance — ownership coverage, stale assets, duplicates — plus a searchable inventory of custom objects, flows, and reports with owner, status, and risk. Admins should be able to assign owners, create remediation tasks, and run scans, and an Agentforce agent should be able to do all of that on their behalf via natural language.

Great, I've scaffolded the Data Curator project. You've got a React governance workspace (dashboard, asset explorer, task queue), four custom objects (Metadata_Asset__c, Governance_Task__c, Scan_Run__c, Governance_Event__c) with permission sets, a set of Agentforce actions for assigning owners, generating cleanup briefs, and running stale-metadata reviews, and an audit Flow that logs every change. Open the Project Brief tab for the full spec — let me know what you want to refine first.
